hyp: Nani ya paʼnawesu yaʼipi tahshiramiachin shaʼwirawe. Nimara ahke taweri pihkeran uʼmarawe, inahsu ku nituhterawe. Ira ahke inaran ikirure, inahsu nahtonawe. Nahpatun penamare, wiʼnau, shaʼwiteke mamaparin kuʼwara wahpuru iʼshake yaʼkunchahtaraʼsuwe.

src: I miss returning like before.
ref: Naʼwanawe ayankamare irahkapuchin.
hyp: Naʼwanankuwe irahka uʼmakasuwe.
